In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''gunrunner''' aided the [[Chubbit resistance]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Chubbit]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]] by smuggling [[Blaster/Legends|weapons]] to the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunner]] was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. When an arms deal went sour upon the arrival of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], the Human fled with his Chubbit contacts, but he spotted someone who appeared to be the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;actually an [[Obi-Wan Kenobi impersonator|actor]] hired by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The gunrunner left Aridus and returned to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Alliance headquarters at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. There, he informed [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] of his sighting, prompting Skywalker to travel to Aridus to meet the man he assumed to be his former Master&mdash;springing Vader's trap in the process.<ref name="CSW10" />
